purpose: Authoritative source candidates for conditional Transaction Command Center evidence. Discovery does not imply a completed search, clearance, legal conclusion, or property-specific match.

statewide_sources.label: NJDEP Recycle Coach
statewide_sources.semantics: NJDEP provides statewide Recycle Coach access for municipal trash and recycling schedules. Watchdog may identify the municipality for every resolved NJ parcel, but it must show an address-specific pickup day only when an authoritative address or route match is actually resolved.

statewide_sources.label: NJDEP County and Municipal Recycling Coordinators
statewide_sources.semantics: Use the current state registry to retrieve the municipality's recycling coordinator/contact. The registry identifies the responsible local contact but does not by itself determine a household collection route.

statewide_sources.label: NJDEP Site Remediation exact parcel evidence
statewide_sources.semantics: Watchdog may attribute CSRR evidence to the subject only after exact municipality code plus block/lot matching. Nearby environmental features remain context only and are never promoted to subject-property records.

statewide_sources.label: FEMA National Flood Hazard Layer
statewide_sources.semantics: Use the subject-address geocode against FEMA NFHL for mapped flood-zone evidence. This is not a lender flood determination, elevation certificate, insurance quote or guarantee of flood conditions.

statewide_sources.label: NJDEP Flood Disclosure Law and Flood Risk Notification Tool
statewide_sources.semantics: New Jersey requires flood-risk disclosures for real-property sales. The NJDEP tool supports the disclosure workflow but is not a title clearance, elevation certificate, insurance determination or guarantee that flooding will or will not occur.

statewide_sources.label: NJ Private Well Testing Act
statewide_sources.semantics: For covered sales using a potable private well, required testing and buyer/seller review of results must be tracked before closing. PWTA is a consumer-information requirement and a result outside a drinking-water standard does not automatically prohibit a sale; local or lender requirements may add obligations.

statewide_sources.label: Federal Lead-Based Paint Disclosure Rule
statewide_sources.agency: US Environmental Protection Agency and US Department of Housing and Urban Development
statewide_sources.semantics: The federal disclosure rule applies to most housing built before 1978 and requires disclosure of known lead information and records. It does not establish that lead is present or absent and it is separate from New Jersey rental lead-safe inspection requirements.

statewide_sources.label: NJ Realty Transfer Fee and GIT/REP Recording Requirements
statewide_sources.agency: NJ Department of the Treasury, Division of Taxation
statewide_sources.semantics: Use current NJ Division of Taxation instructions for Realty Transfer Fee and GIT/REP documents that accompany New Jersey deed recording. Watchdog can surface the source and checklist but the closing attorney, title company and county recording office remain authoritative for the specific recording package.

statewide_sources.label: NJDEP Well Permits & Records
statewide_sources.semantics: NJDEP states it maintains well permits, well records and well decommissioning reports statewide. Property documentation may require DataMiner or an Individual Well Search request. This is not septic-system clearance.

statewide_sources.label: NJDEP Known Contaminated Sites / DataMiner
statewide_sources.semantics: Match by subject address or Program Interest number. Preserve NJDEP active, pending and closed case semantics. Nearby sites are context only and must not be attributed to the subject parcel.

statewide_sources.label: NJDEP Heating Oil Tank / UST Records
statewide_sources.semantics: Use NJDEP UHOT/UST and Site Remediation records for subject-property evidence. An NJDEP remediation case can support follow-up but does not by itself prove a currently installed tank.

statewide_sources.label: NJ DCA Bureau of Housing Inspection Service Portal
statewide_sources.semantics: The portal exposes properties on file with Housing Inspection and may provide inspection reports, registration/inspection certificates and judgments. Local rental licensing and municipal requirements remain separate.

statewide_sources.label: NJ DCA Lead-Based Paint Inspection Program
statewide_sources.semantics: Use for statewide program rules and municipality inspection method. A property-specific valid lead-safe certificate or exemption requires authoritative property/municipal evidence.

statewide_sources.label: NJDEP Gas Utilities Territory Map
statewide_sources.semantics: Identifies likely natural-gas utility territory only. It cannot establish whether the property has service, an open account, a balance, shutoff status, or final utility clearance.

provider_families.discovery_strategy: Official municipal Public Works, sanitation, recycling or route source, with route/address resolution only when the source exposes enough information to match the subject.
provider_families.semantics: Municipality-wide service rules can be shown directly. A weekday must not be labeled as the subject property's regular pickup day unless the official route/address evidence resolves that property.

provider_families.discovery_strategy: Official municipal code/housing department and parcel-search provider when one exists.
provider_families.semantics: An official department route means Watchdog is connected to the enforcing authority, not that a parcel search has been completed. Show None found only after a governed parcel-level search completed successfully.

provider_families.discovery_strategy: Official county Surrogate source by county.
provider_families.semantics: Do not infer death, estate status or probate involvement from names or ownership changes. Use only authorized party information or an authoritative case/document match.

provider_families.discovery_strategy: Official county Sheriff and NJ Judiciary sources by county/case.
provider_families.semantics: Require a parcel, docket or verified party match. A similarly named party is not sufficient.

provider_families.discovery_strategy: Official municipal zoning/planning records and searchable board/permit systems where available.
provider_families.semantics: A zoning map classification is not proof that the present use or improvements are lawful or that all conditions were satisfied.

provider_families.discovery_strategy: Official municipal rental/code/housing source where applicable, reconciled with NJ DCA Housing Inspection data.
provider_families.semantics: Requirements vary by municipality and building type. Missing source coverage must remain unknown, not not-required.

provider_families.discovery_strategy: County/local health department or municipal health records where authoritative property-level records exist.
provider_families.semantics: No universal statewide property-level septic clearance source is assumed. Well records and septic records are separate evidence families.
